_comment: EBX CLOBBERER PINNING -- __watcall declares EBX <unaffected>, and the functions listed here do
not preserve it. This manifest pins each to a model whose killedbycall matches what it actually
clobbers. The models already existed from the 2026-08-03 legacy-convention migration, so this
DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED, and the exclusions are most of the raw count:
* unknown/default functions that clobber NEITHER register. Their effective model is already
__watcall (it is the default_proto), so pinning them explicitly is churn with no semantic
* EBX clobberers on __stdcall / __fastcall / __cdecl. Different INPUT contract; a
__watcall-derived model would move their parameters, which is worse than the bug.
GENERATED: run mh_classify_reg_preservation.py in Ghidra, then
`python tools/gen_reg_clobberers.py`. Applied by mh_set_calling_convention.py. Re-run the
classifier after anything that changes function bodies.
